changelog: 🐚 Phase 3 Upgrade: Pure Rust Native PTY & Subprocess Supervisor (`portable-pty` & `libc`): Full bidirectional pseudo-terminal emulation for interactive CLI tools.
⚡ Zero Orphaned Processes: Subprocess group isolation (`-PID` signal dispatch) terminates runaway dev servers, python/node scripts, and child shells cleanly.
🌐 WebSocket Terminal Multiplexer: Dedicated `/ws/terminal/:id` and REST APIs (`/api/terminal/*`) with real-time bidirectional byte streaming, resize handling, and ANSI escape preservation.
